items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When Javon couldn’t do it, we used Pee Wee.

ctx.x: . . . Larry Willis, and Buster Williams. That’s what it was. When Buster got sick, we used John Webber. That works out pretty good.
When Javon couldn’t do it, we used Pee Wee.
We used Pee Wee Ellis. We used Pee Wee Ellis for one gig and – where was that? What’s the name? Frome? What’s the name of that place?
